name: Ledger history + drill-in to /structure
notes: Re-verified goal-desk-iter-26 by browser-qa-agent (2026-07-30) live against the running rig at backend :8301 / frontend :3301, serving the real ambient apps/backend/.data store. This iteration shipped J-17 (top-up window-derivation + Top-up Runs disclosure); J-05's own surface (Screen History + /structure query-param prefill) was untouched by this iteration's diff, so this run re-verifies it end to end as a regression check per the dispatch instructions.

Precondition note: the ambient frontend (:3301) was serving a stale/corrupted .next build ('Cannot find module ./885.js', GET / 500) at the start of this dispatch -- the T-9 clean-rebuild trap goal.md warns about. Remediated with rm -rf apps/frontend/.next + a clean restart on the same port before any evidence was captured; all evidence in this script is post-remediation.

This iteration's own deterministic replay of the previous version of this script reported a step-07 FAIL ('expect not satisfied') before this browser-qa-agent run -- the same flake class the iter-19/iter-25 predecessor runs of this exact script diagnosed as a cold Next.js dev-server JIT-compile on /structure's first hit, not a functional regression (see prior notes). Live re-verification this run reproduced every step successfully end to end: clicking the 2026-06-22 Screen History row rendered its recorded rows verbatim (confirmed via DOM eval: 'Viewing the recorded screen for 2026-06-22 -- not the latest.' banner present, desk-history-latest-button present, 10 desk-screen-row elements, first row href '/structure?symbol=AAPL&asof=2026-06-22T23%3A59%3A59Z'); clicking that first ranked row navigated to /structure?symbol=AAPL&asof=2026-06-22T23%3A59%3A59Z, auto-loaded, and the tradable-map-table rendered the exact pinned wall region -- both 'resistance 298.02-300.1001 Class A 97' and the well-known 'resistance 300.11-302.2 Class A 171' wall -- confirmed via direct DOM text extraction and screenshot (reports/qa/goal-desk-iter-26-evidence/UT-J-05-drillin-structure-aapl.png). /structure with no query params was independently re-verified to show its exact shipped default empty state (symbol input blank, no auto-load) -- reports/qa/goal-desk-iter-26-evidence/UT-J-05-structure-no-params-default.png.

This script raises default_timeout_ms and keeps a pre-assertion wait via the step-06 delay to reduce the cold-compile flake risk without changing what is asserted -- unchanged from the prior verified version.
